=== FILE: lib/core/constants/map_constants.dart ===
/// All map settings live here, so we can change the tile provider
/// in ONE place later (for example when we move to our own tile server).
class MapConstants {
  MapConstants._();

  /// Free OpenFreeMap style. Map data comes from OpenStreetMap.
  /// - No API key and no account needed.
  /// - It is a public service run on donations with NO guarantee of
  ///   availability, so it is fine for development and testing, but we must
  ///   plan our own tile hosting (or a paid SLA provider) before a real launch.
  /// - MapLibre shows the required attribution on the map automatically.
  static const String styleUrl = 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty';

  /// Center of Rajshahi city.
  static const double rajshahiLat = 24.3745;
  static const double rajshahiLng = 88.6042;

  /// Zoom when the map first opens (whole city visible).
  static const double defaultZoom = 12.5;

  /// Zoom when we jump to the user's position (street level).
  static const double userZoom = 16;
}

=== FILE: lib/core/services/location_service.dart ===
import 'package:geolocator/geolocator.dart';

/// The four situations our app cares about.
enum LocationStatus {
  /// GPS is on and the user allowed location. All good.
  granted,

  /// The phone's GPS / location switch is turned off.
  serviceDisabled,

  /// The user said "No" (we may ask again).
  denied,

  /// The user said "Don't ask again". Only phone Settings can fix it.
  deniedForever,
}

/// Small helper around the `geolocator` package, so the rest of the app
/// never talks to geolocator directly.
class LocationService {
  LocationService._();

  /// Checks GPS and permission.
  /// If [askPermission] is true, shows the Android permission pop-up when needed.
  static Future<LocationStatus> check({required bool askPermission}) async {
    final serviceEnabled = await Geolocator.isLocationServiceEnabled();
    if (!serviceEnabled) return LocationStatus.serviceDisabled;

    var permission = await Geolocator.checkPermission();
    if (permission == LocationPermission.denied && askPermission) {
      permission = await Geolocator.requestPermission();
    }

    switch (permission) {
      case LocationPermission.whileInUse:
      case LocationPermission.always:
        return LocationStatus.granted;
      case LocationPermission.deniedForever:
        return LocationStatus.deniedForever;
      case LocationPermission.denied:
      case LocationPermission.unableToDetermine:
        return LocationStatus.denied;
    }
  }

  /// Returns the user's position, or null if it could not be found.
  /// Only call this after [check] returned [LocationStatus.granted].
  static Future<Position?> getCurrentPosition() async {
    try {
      return await Geolocator.getCurrentPosition(
        locationSettings: const LocationSettings(
          accuracy: LocationAccuracy.high,
          timeLimit: Duration(seconds: 15),
        ),
      );
    } catch (_) {
      // No fresh GPS fix in time. Try the last position the phone remembers.
      try {
        return await Geolocator.getLastKnownPosition();
      } catch (_) {
        return null;
      }
    }
  }

  /// Opens the phone's location (GPS) switch screen.
  static Future<bool> openLocationSettings() => Geolocator.openLocationSettings();

  /// Opens RajRide's page in the phone's app settings.
  static Future<bool> openAppSettings() => Geolocator.openAppSettings();
}

=== FILE: lib/core/theme/app_theme.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../constants/app_colors.dart';

/// The overall look of the app (green and white theme).
class AppTheme {
  AppTheme._();

  static ThemeData get light {
    return ThemeData(
      useMaterial3: true,
      colorScheme: ColorScheme.fromSeed(
        seedColor: AppColors.primary,
        primary: AppColors.primary,
      ),
      scaffoldBackgroundColor: AppColors.background,
      elevatedButtonTheme: ElevatedButtonThemeData(
        style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
          backgroundColor: AppColors.primary,
          foregroundColor: Colors.white,
          minimumSize: const Size.fromHeight(52),
          shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../shared/widgets/rajride_logo.dart';
import '../map/map_screen.dart';

/// The main screen. Most buttons still show a "coming soon" message.
/// The map card opens the map (Day 4).
class HomeScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const HomeScreen({super.key});

  void _showComingSoon(BuildContext context, String feature) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('$feature - coming soon!')));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: SafeArea(
        child: SingleChildScrollView(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              _buildHeader(),
              const SizedBox(height: 20),
              _buildSearchBox(context),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              const Text(
                'Choose your ride',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 18,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: AppColors.textDark,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 12),
              _buildRideOptions(context),
              const SizedBox(height: 24),
              _buildMapCard(context),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
      bottomNavigationBar: NavigationBar(
        selectedIndex: 0,
        onDestinationSelected: (index) {
          if (index == 1) _showComingSoon(context, 'Activity');
          if (index == 2) _showComingSoon(context, 'Account');
        },
        destinations: const [
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.home_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.home),
            label: 'Home',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.receipt_long_outlined),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.receipt_long),
            label: 'Activity',
          ),
          NavigationDestination(
            icon: Icon(Icons.person_outline),
            selectedIcon: Icon(Icons.person),
            label: 'Account',
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildHeader() {
    return const Row(
      children: [
        RajRideLogo(size: 46),
        SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                'Welcome to RajRide',
                style: TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 20,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  color: AppColors.textDark,
                ),
              ),
              SizedBox(height: 2),
              Row(
                children: [
                  Icon(Icons.location_on, size: 16, color: AppColors.primary),
                  SizedBox(width: 4),
                  Text(
                    'Rajshahi, Bangladesh',
                    style: TextStyle(color: AppColors.textGrey),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        Icon(Icons.notifications_none, color: AppColors.textDark),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildSearchBox(BuildContext context) {
    return Material(
      color: AppColors.surface,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      elevation: 2,
      shadowColor: Colors.black26,
      child: InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        onTap: () => _showComingSoon(context, 'Destination search'),
        child: const Padding(
          padding: EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 18),
          child: Row(
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.search, color: AppColors.primary),
              SizedBox(width: 12),
              Text(
                'Where to?',
                style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: AppColors.textGrey),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildRideOptions(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Expanded(
          child: _RideOption(
            icon: Icons.two_wheeler,
            label: 'Bike',
            enabled: true,
            onTap: () => _showComingSoon(context, 'Bike ride'),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: _RideOption(
            icon: Icons.directions_car,
            label: 'Car',
            enabled: false,
            onTap: () => _showComingSoon(context, 'Car ride'),
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 12),
        Expanded(
          child: _RideOption(
            icon: Icons.electric_rickshaw,
            label: 'CNG',
            enabled: false,
            onTap: () => _showComingSoon(context, 'CNG ride'),
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildMapCard(BuildContext context) {
    return Material(
      color: AppColors.primaryLight,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      child: InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
        onTap: () {
          // push (not pushReplacement): the Back button returns to Home.
          Navigator.of(context).push(
            MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const MapScreen()),
          );
        },
        child: const SizedBox(
          height: 200,
          width: double.infinity,
          child: Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              Icon(Icons.map_outlined, size: 48, color: AppColors.primary),
              SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                'Open map',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: AppColors.primaryDark,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  fontSize: 16,
                ),
              ),
              SizedBox(height: 2),
              Text(
                'See Rajshahi and your location',
                style: TextStyle(color: AppColors.textGrey),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// One ride type card (Bike / Car / CNG).
class _RideOption extends StatelessWidget {
  const _RideOption({
    required this.icon,
    required this.label,
    required this.enabled,
    required this.onTap,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String label;
  final bool enabled;
  final VoidCallback onTap;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final Color color = enabled ? AppColors.primary : Colors.grey;

    return Material(
      color: AppColors.surface,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      elevation: 1,
      shadowColor: Colors.black26,
      child: InkWell(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
        onTap: onTap,
        child: Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 18),
          child: Column(
            children: [
              Icon(icon, size: 34, color: color),
              const SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                label,
                style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.w600, color: color),
              ),
              if (!enabled)
                const Text(
                  'Soon',
                  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 11, color: Colors.grey),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: lib/features/map/map_screen.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:maplibre_gl/maplibre_gl.dart';

import '../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../core/constants/map_constants.dart';
import '../../core/services/location_service.dart';

/// All texts of this screen in one place.
/// (Day 3 Bangla/English support has not been built yet. When it is,
/// these are the texts to translate.)
class _Texts {
  static const loading = 'Loading map… (internet needed)';
  static const gpsOff = 'Your GPS is turned off. Turn it on to see where you are.';
  static const turnOnGps = 'Turn on GPS';
  static const denied = 'RajRide needs your permission to show where you are.';
  static const allow = 'Allow location';
  static const deniedForever =
      'Location permission is blocked. Open settings and allow location for RajRide.';
  static const openSettings = 'Open settings';
  static const noFix = 'Couldn’t find your location yet. Please try again.';
  static const myLocation = 'My location';
}

/// Interactive map centered on Rajshahi. Shows the user's location when allowed.
class MapScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const MapScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<MapScreen> createState() => _MapScreenState();
}

class _MapScreenState extends State<MapScreen> with WidgetsBindingObserver {
  MapLibreMapController? _controller;
  LocationStatus? _status;
  bool _styleLoaded = false;
  bool _didCenterOnUser = false;

  bool get _locationGranted => _status == LocationStatus.granted;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    WidgetsBinding.instance.addObserver(this);
    _checkLocation(askPermission: true);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    WidgetsBinding.instance.removeObserver(this);
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// When the user comes back from phone Settings, check again (no pop-up).
  @override
  void didChangeAppLifecycleState(AppLifecycleState state) {
    if (state == AppLifecycleState.resumed) {
      _checkLocation(askPermission: false);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _checkLocation({required bool askPermission}) async {
    final status = await LocationService.check(askPermission: askPermission);
    if (!mounted) return;
    setState(() => _status = status);
    if (status == LocationStatus.granted && !_didCenterOnUser) {
      await _moveToUser();
    }
  }

  void _onMapCreated(MapLibreMapController controller) {
    _controller = controller;
    if (_locationGranted && !_didCenterOnUser) {
      _moveToUser();
    }
  }

  /// Smoothly moves the camera to the user's current position.
  Future<void> _moveToUser({bool showError = false}) async {
    final controller = _controller;
    if (controller == null) return;

    final position = await LocationService.getCurrentPosition();
    if (!mounted) return;
    if (position == null) {
      if (showError) _showMessage(_Texts.noFix);
      return;
    }

    _didCenterOnUser = true;
    await controller.animateCamera(
      CameraUpdate.newLatLngZoom(
        LatLng(position.latitude, position.longitude),
        MapConstants.userZoom,
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _onLocationButtonPressed() async {
    var status = _status;
    if (status != LocationStatus.granted) {
      status = await LocationService.check(askPermission: true);
      if (!mounted) return;
      setState(() => _status = status);
    }
    if (status == LocationStatus.granted) {
      await _moveToUser(showError: true);
    }
  }

  Future<void> _onBannerActionPressed() async {
    switch (_status) {
      case LocationStatus.serviceDisabled:
        await LocationService.openLocationSettings();
      case LocationStatus.deniedForever:
        await LocationService.openAppSettings();
      case LocationStatus.denied:
      case LocationStatus.granted:
      case null:
        await _checkLocation(askPermission: true);
    }
  }

  void _showMessage(String text) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)
      ..hideCurrentSnackBar()
      ..showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text(text)));
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: Stack(
        children: [
          MapLibreMap(
            styleString: MapConstants.styleUrl,
            initialCameraPosition: const CameraPosition(
              target: LatLng(MapConstants.rajshahiLat, MapConstants.rajshahiLng),
              zoom: MapConstants.defaultZoom,
            ),
            onMapCreated: _onMapCreated,
            onStyleLoadedCallback: () {
              if (mounted) setState(() => _styleLoaded = true);
            },
            myLocationEnabled: _locationGranted,
            compassEnabled: true,
          ),
          if (!_styleLoaded) _buildLoadingOverlay(),
          Positioned.fill(
            child: SafeArea(
              child: Padding(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                child: Stack(
                  children: [
                    Align(
                      alignment: Alignment.topCenter,
                      child: _buildTopArea(),
                    ),
                    Align(
                      alignment: Alignment.bottomRight,
                      child: FloatingActionButton(
                        tooltip: _Texts.myLocation,
                        backgroundColor: Colors.white,
                        foregroundColor: AppColors.primary,
                        onPressed: _onLocationButtonPressed,
                        child: const Icon(Icons.my_location),
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLoadingOverlay() {
    return Positioned.fill(
      child: Container(
        color: AppColors.primaryLight,
        child: const Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            CircularProgressIndicator(color: AppColors.primary),
            SizedBox(height: 16),
            Text(
              _Texts.loading,
              style: TextStyle(color: AppColors.primaryDark),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Back button, plus a warning card when location is not available.
  Widget _buildTopArea() {
    return Column(
      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Align(
          alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
          child: Material(
            color: Colors.white,
            shape: const CircleBorder(),
            elevation: 3,
            child: IconButton(
              icon: const Icon(Icons.arrow_back, color: AppColors.textDark),
              onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(),
            ),
          ),
        ),
        if (_status != null && !_locationGranted) ...[
          const SizedBox(height: 12),
          _buildLocationBanner(),
        ],
      ],
    );
  }

  Widget _buildLocationBanner() {
    final String message;
    final String buttonLabel;
    switch (_status) {
      case LocationStatus.serviceDisabled:
        message = _Texts.gpsOff;
        buttonLabel = _Texts.turnOnGps;
      case LocationStatus.deniedForever:
        message = _Texts.deniedForever;
        buttonLabel = _Texts.openSettings;
      case LocationStatus.denied:
      case LocationStatus.granted:
      case null:
        message = _Texts.denied;
        buttonLabel = _Texts.allow;
    }

    return Material(
      color: Colors.white,
      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      elevation: 3,
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(14),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Icon(Icons.location_off, color: AppColors.primary),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    message,
                    style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.textDark),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            Align(
              alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
              child: TextButton(
                onPressed: _onBannerActionPressed,
                child: Text(buttonLabel),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

=== FILE: lib/features/splash/splash_screen.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../shared/widgets/rajride_logo.dart';
import '../welcome/welcome_screen.dart';

/// Shown for about 2.5 seconds when the app opens, then goes to Welcome.
class SplashScreen extends StatefulWidget {
  const SplashScreen({super.key});

  @override
  State<SplashScreen> createState() => _SplashScreenState();
}

class _SplashScreenState extends State<SplashScreen>
    with SingleTickerProviderStateMixin {
  late final AnimationController _controller;
  late final Animation<double> _fade;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _controller = AnimationController(
      vsync: this,
      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 1200),
    );
    _fade = CurvedAnimation(parent: _controller, curve: Curves.easeIn);
    _controller.forward();

    Future.delayed(const Duration(milliseconds: 2500), _goToWelcome);
  }

  void _goToWelcome() {
    if (!mounted) return;
    Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const WelcomeScreen()),
    );
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _controller.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: Container(
        width: double.infinity,
        decoration: const BoxDecoration(
          gradient: LinearGradient(
            begin: Alignment.topCenter,
            end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
            colors: [AppColors.primary, AppColors.primaryDark],
          ),
        ),
        child: FadeTransition(
          opacity: _fade,
          child: const Column(
            mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
            children: [
              RajRideLogo(size: 120, light: true),
              SizedBox(height: 24),
              Text(
                'RajRide',
                style: TextStyle(
                  color: Colors.white,
                  fontSize: 36,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  letterSpacing: 1,
                ),
              ),
              SizedBox(height: 8),
              Text(
                'Your ride, your Rajshahi',
                style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70, fontSize: 16),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';
import '../../shared/widgets/rajride_logo.dart';
import '../home/home_screen.dart';

/// Shown after the splash screen. The "Get Started" button opens Home.
class WelcomeScreen extends StatelessWidget {
  const WelcomeScreen({super.key});

  void _goToHome(BuildContext context) {
    // pushReplacement means the Back button will NOT return to this screen.
    Navigator.of(context).pushReplacement(
      MaterialPageRoute(builder: (_) => const HomeScreen()),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      body: SingleChildScrollView(
        child: Column(
          children: [
            _buildHero(),
            Padding(
              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(24, 28, 24, 24),
              child: Column(
                crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'Welcome to RajRide',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 28,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      color: AppColors.textDark,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 8),
                  const Text(
                    'Safe, simple and affordable rides in Rajshahi.',
                    style: TextStyle(fontSize: 16, color: AppColors.textGrey),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 28),
                  const _FeatureTile(
                    icon: Icons.shield_outlined,
                    title: 'Safe rides',
                    subtitle: 'Trusted drivers and trip safety tools',
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  const _FeatureTile(
                    icon: Icons.payments_outlined,
                    title: 'Fair fares in BDT',
                    subtitle: 'Know the estimated price before you ride',
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 16),
                  const _FeatureTile(
                    icon: Icons.bolt_outlined,
                    title: 'Quick pickup',
                    subtitle: 'Find a nearby ride in minutes',
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 36),
                  ElevatedButton(
                    onPressed: () => _goToHome(context),
                    child: const Text(
                      'Get Started',
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 16,
                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),
                  const Center(
                    child: Text(
                      'Now available in Rajshahi',
                      style: TextStyle(color: AppColors.textGrey),
                    ),
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  /// The green curved area at the top with the logo.
  Widget _buildHero() {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      height: 300,
      decoration: const BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topCenter,
          end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          colors: [AppColors.primary, AppColors.primaryDark],
        ),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.only(
          bottomLeft: Radius.circular(40),
          bottomRight: Radius.circular(40),
        ),
      ),
      child: const SafeArea(
        child: Center(child: RajRideLogo(size: 120, light: true)),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// One row with a round icon, a title and a short description.
class _FeatureTile extends StatelessWidget {
  const _FeatureTile({
    required this.icon,
    required this.title,
    required this.subtitle,
  });

  final IconData icon;
  final String title;
  final String subtitle;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        Container(
          width: 48,
          height: 48,
          decoration: const BoxDecoration(
            color: AppColors.primaryLight,
            shape: BoxShape.circle,
          ),
          child: Icon(icon, color: AppColors.primary),
        ),
        const SizedBox(width: 16),
        Expanded(
          child: Column(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              Text(
                title,
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 16,
                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  color: AppColors.textDark,
                ),
              ),
              const SizedBox(height: 2),
              Text(
                subtitle,
                style: const TextStyle(color: AppColors.textGrey),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}

  const RajRideApp({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'RajRide',
      debugShowCheckedModeBanner: false,

=== FILE: lib/shared/widgets/rajride_logo.dart ===
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../../core/constants/app_colors.dart';

/// A simple round RajRide logo (temporary icon-based logo).
/// Set [light] to true to show a white logo on a green background.
class RajRideLogo extends StatelessWidget {
  const RajRideLogo({super.key, this.size = 96, this.light = false});

  final double size;
  final bool light;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      width: size,
      height: size,
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: light ? Colors.white : AppColors.primary,
        shape: BoxShape.circle,
        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.black.withAlpha(40),
            blurRadius: size * 0.2,
            offset: Offset(0, size * 0.06),
          ),
        ],
      ),
      child: Icon(
        Icons.two_wheeler,
        size: size * 0.55,
        color: light ? AppColors.primary : Colors.white,
      ),
    );
  }
}
